09.L92:
<n>92:2</n> Paráta sedes tua ex tunc: * a sǽculo tu es.
<n>92:5</n> Testimónia tua credibília facta sunt nimis: * domum tuam decet sanctitúdo, Dómine, in longitúdinem diérum.
09.E92:
<n>92:2</n> Thy throne is prepared from of old: * thou art from everlasting.
<n>92:5</n> Thy testimonies are become exceedingly credible: * holiness becometh thy house, O Lord, unto length of days.
09.L90:
<n>90:1</n> Qui hábitat in adjutório Altíssimi, * in protectióne Dei cæli commorábitur.
<n>90:2</n> Dicet Dómino: Suscéptor meus es tu, et refúgium meum: * Deus meus sperábo in eum.
<n>90:3</n> Quóniam ipse liberávit me de láqueo venántium, * et a verbo áspero.
<n>90:4</n> Scápulis suis obumbrábit tibi: * et sub pennis ejus sperábis.
<n>90:5</n> Scuto circúmdabit te véritas ejus: * non timébis a timóre noctúrno,
<n>90:6</n> A sagítta volánte in die, † a negótio perambulánte in ténebris: * ab incúrsu, et dæmónio meridiáno.
<n>90:7</n> Cadent a látere tuo mille, † et decem míllia a dextris tuis: * ad te autem non appropinquábit.
<n>90:8</n> Verúmtamen óculis tuis considerábis: * et retributiónem peccatórum vidébis.
<n>90:9</n> Quóniam tu es, Dómine, spes mea: * Altíssimum posuísti refúgium tuum.
<n>90:10</n> Non accédet ad te malum: * et flagéllum non appropinquábit tabernáculo tuo.
<n>90:11</n> Quóniam Ángelis suis mandávit de te: * ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
<n>90:12</n> In mánibus portábunt te: * ne forte offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.
<n>90:13</n> Super áspidem, et basilíscum ambulábis: * et conculcábis leónem et dracónem.
<n>90:14</n> Quóniam in me sperávit, liberábo eum: * prótegam eum, quóniam cognóvit nomen meum.
<n>90:15</n> Clamábit ad me, et ego exáudiam eum: cum ipso sum in tribulatióne: * erípiam eum et glorificábo eum.
<n>90:16</n> Longitúdine diérum replébo eum: * et osténdam illi salutáre meum.
09.E90:
<n>90:1</n> He that dwelleth in the aid of the most High, * shall abide under the protection of the God of Jacob.
<n>90:2</n> He shall say to the Lord: Thou art my protector, and my refuge: * my God, in him will I trust.
<n>90:3</n> For he hath delivered me from the snare of the hunters: * and from the sharp word.
<n>90:4</n> He will overshadow thee with his shoulders: * and under his wings thou shalt trust.
<n>90:5</n> His truth shall compass thee with a shield: * thou shalt not be afraid of the terror of the night.
<n>90:6</n> Of the arrow that flieth in the day, † of the business that walketh about in the dark: * of invasion, or of the noonday devil.
<n>90:7</n> A thousand shall fall at thy side, † and ten thousand at thy right hand: * but it shall not come nigh thee.
<n>90:8</n> But thou shalt consider with thy eyes: * and shalt see the reward of the wicked.
<n>90:9</n> Because thou, O Lord, art my hope: * thou hast made the most High thy refuge.
<n>90:10</n> There shall no evil come to thee: * nor shall the scourge come near thy dwelling.
<n>90:11</n> For he hath given his angels charge over thee; * to keep thee in all thy ways.
<n>90:12</n> In their hands they shall bear thee up: * lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
<n>90:13</n> Thou shalt walk upon the asp and the basilisk: * and thou shalt trample under foot the lion and the dragon.
<n>90:14</n> Because he hoped in me I will deliver him: * I will protect him because he hath known my name.
<n>90:15</n> He shall cry to me, and I will hear him: I am with him in tribulation, * I will deliver him, and I will glorify him.
<n>90:16</n> I will fill him with length of days; * and I will shew him my salvation.
09.L93:
<n>93:1</n> Deus ultiónum Dóminus: * Deus ultiónum líbere egit.
<n>93:2</n> Exaltáre, qui júdicas terram: * redde retributiónem supérbis.
<n>93:3</n> Úsquequo peccatóres, Dómine, * úsquequo peccatóres gloriabúntur:
<n>93:4</n> Effabúntur, et loquéntur iniquitátem: * loquéntur omnes, qui operántur injustítiam?
<n>93:5</n> Pópulum tuum, Dómine, humiliavérunt: * et hereditátem tuam vexavérunt.
<n>93:6</n> Víduam, et ádvenam interfecérunt: * et pupíllos occidérunt.
<n>93:7</n> Et dixérunt: Non vidébit Dóminus, * nec intélleget Deus Jacob.
<n>93:8</n> Intellégite, insipiéntes in pópulo: * et stulti, aliquándo sápite.
<n>93:9</n> Qui plantávit aurem, non áudiet? * aut qui finxit óculum, non consíderat?
<n>93:10</n> Qui córripit gentes, non árguet: * qui docet hóminem sciéntiam?
<n>93:11</n> Dóminus scit cogitatiónes hóminum, * quóniam vanæ sunt.
<n>93:12</n> Beátus homo, quem tu erudíeris, Dómine: * et de lege tua docúeris eum,
<n>93:13</n> Ut mítiges ei a diébus malis: * donec fodiátur peccatóri fóvea.
<n>93:14</n> Quia non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: * et hereditátem suam non derelínquet.
<n>93:15</n> Quoadúsque justítia convertátur in judícium: * et qui juxta illam omnes qui recto sunt corde.
<n>93:16</n> Quis consúrget mihi advérsus malignántes? * aut quis stabit mecum advérsus operántes iniquitátem?
<n>93:17</n> Nisi quia Dóminus adjúvit me: * paulo minus habitásset in inférno ánima mea.
<n>93:18</n> Si dicébam: Motus est pes meus: * misericórdia tua, Dómine, adjuvábat me.
<n>93:19</n> Secúndum multitúdinem dolórum meórum in corde meo: * consolatiónes tuæ lætificavérunt ánimam meam.
<n>93:20</n> Numquid adhǽret tibi sedes iniquitátis: * qui fingis labórem in præcépto?
<n>93:21</n> Captábunt in ánimam justi: * et sánguinem innocéntem condemnábunt.
<n>93:22</n> Et factus est mihi Dóminus in refúgium: * et Deus meus in adjutórium spei meæ.
<n>93:23</n> Et reddet illis iniquitátem ipsórum: et in malítia eórum dispérdet eos: * dispérdet illos Dóminus, Deus noster.
09.L95:
<n>95:1</n> Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * cantáte Dómino, omnis terra.
<n>95:2</n> Cantáte Dómino, et benedícite nómini ejus: * annuntiáte de die in diem salutáre ejus.
<n>95:3</n> Annuntiáte inter gentes glóriam ejus, * in ómnibus pópulis mirabília ejus.
<n>95:4</n> Quóniam magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis: * terríbilis est super omnes deos.
<n>95:5</n> Quóniam omnes dii géntium dæmónia: * Dóminus autem cælos fecit.
<n>95:6</n> Conféssio, et pulchritúdo in conspéctu ejus: * sanctimónia et magnificéntia in sanctificatióne ejus.
<n>95:7</n> Afférte Dómino, pátriæ géntium, afférte Dómino glóriam et honórem: * afférte Dómino glóriam nómini ejus.
<n>95:8</n> Tóllite hóstias, et introíte in átria ejus: * adoráte Dóminum in átrio sancto ejus.
<n>95:9</n> Commoveátur a fácie ejus univérsa terra: * dícite in géntibus quia Dóminus regnávit.
<n>95:10</n> Étenim corréxit orbem terræ qui non commovébitur: * judicábit pópulos in æquitáte.
<n>95:11</n> Læténtur cæli, et exsúltet terra: commoveátur mare, et plenitúdo ejus: * gaudébunt campi, et ómnia quæ in eis sunt.
<n>95:12</n> Tunc exsultábunt ómnia ligna silvárum a fácie Dómini, quia venit: * quóniam venit judicáre terram.
<n>95:13</n> Judicábit orbem terræ in æquitáte, * et pópulos in veritáte sua.
09.L96:
<n>96:1</n> Dóminus regnávit, exsúltet terra: * læténtur ínsulæ multæ.
<n>96:2</n> Nubes, et calígo in circúitu ejus: * justítia, et judícium corréctio sedis ejus.
<n>96:3</n> Ignis ante ipsum præcédet, * et inflammábit in circúitu inimícos ejus.
<n>96:4</n> Illuxérunt fúlgura ejus orbi terræ: * vidit, et commóta est terra.
<n>96:5</n> Montes, sicut cera fluxérunt a fácie Dómini: * a fácie Dómini omnis terra.
<n>96:6</n> Annuntiavérunt cæli justítiam ejus: * et vidérunt omnes pópuli glóriam ejus.
<n>96:7</n> Confundántur omnes, qui adórant sculptília: * et qui gloriántur in simulácris suis.
<n>96:7</n> Adoráte eum, omnes Ángeli ejus: * audívit, et lætáta est Sion.
<n>96:8</n> Et exsultavérunt fíliæ Judæ, * propter judícia tua, Dómine:
<n>96:9</n> Quóniam tu Dóminus Altíssimus super omnem terram: * nimis exaltátus es super omnes deos.
<n>96:10</n> Qui dilígitis Dóminum, odíte malum: * custódit Dóminus ánimas sanctórum suórum, de manu peccatóris liberábit eos.
<n>96:11</n> Lux orta est justo, * et rectis corde lætítia.
<n>96:12</n> Lætámini, justi, in Dómino: * et confitémini memóriæ sanctificatiónis ejus.
09.E93:
<n>93:1</n> The Lord is the God to whom revenge belongeth: * the God of revenge hath acted freely.
<n>93:2</n> Lift up thyself, thou that judgest the earth: * render a reward to the proud.
<n>93:3</n> How long shall sinners, O Lord: * how long shall sinners glory?
<n>93:4</n> Shall they utter, and speak iniquity: * shall all speak who work injustice?
<n>93:5</n> Thy people, O Lord, they have brought low: * and they have afflicted thy inheritance.
<n>93:6</n> They have slain the widow and the stranger: * and they have murdered the fatherless.
<n>93:7</n> And they have said: The Lord shall not see: * neither shall the God of Jacob understand.
<n>93:8</n> Understand, ye senseless among the people: * and, you fools, be wise at last.
<n>93:9</n> He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? * or he that formed the eye, doth he not consider?
<n>93:10</n> He that chastiseth nations, shall he not rebuke: * he that teacheth man knowledge?
<n>93:11</n> The Lord knoweth the thoughts of men, * that they are vain.
<n>93:12</n> Blessed is the man whom thou shalt instruct, O Lord: * and shalt teach him out of thy law.
<n>93:13</n> That thou mayst give him rest from the evil days: * till a pit be dug for the wicked.
<n>93:14</n> For the Lord will not cast off his people: * neither will he forsake his own inheritance.
<n>93:15</n> Until justice be turned into judgment: * and they that are near it are all the upright in heart.
<n>93:16</n> Who shall rise up for me against the evildoers? * or who shall stand with me against the workers of iniquity?
<n>93:17</n> Unless the Lord had been my helper, * my soul had almost dwelt in hell.
<n>93:18</n> If I said: My foot is moved: * thy mercy, O Lord, assisted me.
<n>93:19</n> According to the multitude of my sorrows in my heart, * thy comforts have given joy to my soul.
<n>93:20</n> Doth the seat of iniquity stick to thee, * who framest labour in commandment?
<n>93:21</n> They will hunt after the soul of the just, * and will condemn innocent blood.
<n>93:22</n> But the Lord is my refuge: * and my God the help of my hope.
<n>93:23</n> And he will render them their iniquity: and in their malice he will destroy them: * the Lord our God will destroy them.
09.E95:
<n>95:1</n> Sing ye to the Lord a new canticle: * sing to the Lord, all the earth.
<n>95:2</n> Sing ye to the Lord and bless his name: * shew forth his salvation from day to day.
<n>95:3</n> Declare his glory among the Gentiles: * his wonders among all people.
<n>95:4</n> For the Lord is great, and exceedingly to be praised: * he is to be feared above all gods.
<n>95:5</n> For all the gods of the Gentiles are devils: * but the Lord made the heavens.
<n>95:6</n> Praise and beauty are before him: * holiness and majesty in his sanctuary.
<n>95:7</n> Bring ye to the Lord, O ye kindreds of the Gentiles, bring ye to the Lord glory and honour: * bring to the Lord glory unto his name.
<n>95:8</n> Bring up sacrifices, and come into his courts: * adore ye the Lord in his holy court.
<n>95:9</n> Let all the earth be moved at his presence. * Say ye among the Gentiles, the Lord hath reigned.
<n>95:10</n> For he hath corrected the world, which shall not be moved: * he will judge the people with justice.
<n>95:11</n> Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad, let the sea be moved, and the fulness thereof: * the fields and all things that are in them shall be joyful.
<n>95:12</n> Then shall all the trees of the woods rejoice before the face of the Lord, because he cometh: * because he cometh to judge the earth.
<n>95:13</n> He shall judge the world with justice, * and the people with his truth.
09.E96:
<n>96:1</n> The Lord hath reigned, let the earth rejoice: * let many islands be glad.
<n>96:2</n> Clouds and darkness are round about him: * justice and judgment are the establishment of his throne.
<n>96:3</n> A fire shall go before him, * and shall burn his enemies round about.
<n>96:4</n> His lightnings have shone forth to the world: * the earth saw and trembled.
<n>96:5</n> The mountains melted like wax, at the presence of the Lord: * at the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
<n>96:6</n> The heavens declared his justice: * and all people saw his glory.
<n>96:7</n> Let them be all confounded that adore graven things, * and that glory in their idols.
<n>96:7</n> Adore him, all you his angels: * Sion heard, and was glad.
<n>96:8</n> And the daughters of Juda rejoiced, * because of thy judgments, O Lord.
<n>96:9</n> For thou art the most high Lord over all the earth: * thou art exalted exceedingly above all gods.
<n>96:10</n> You that love the Lord, hate evil: * the Lord preserveth the souls of his saints, he will deliver them out of the hand of the sinner.
<n>96:11</n> Light is risen to the just, * and joy to the right of heart.
<n>96:12</n> Rejoice, ye just, in the Lord: * and give praise to the remembrance of his holiness.
09.L97:
<n>97:1</n> Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * quia mirabília fecit.
<n>97:1</n> Salvávit sibi déxtera ejus: * et brácchium sanctum ejus.
<n>97:2</n> Notum fecit Dóminus salutáre suum: * in conspéctu géntium revelávit justítiam suam.
<n>97:3</n> Recordátus est misericórdiæ suæ, * et veritátis suæ dómui Israël.
<n>97:3</n> Vidérunt omnes términi terræ * salutáre Dei nostri.
<n>97:4</n> Jubiláte Deo, omnis terra: * cantáte, et exsultáte, et psállite.
<n>97:5</n> Psállite Dómino in cíthara, in cíthara et voce psalmi: * in tubis ductílibus, et voce tubæ córneæ.
<n>97:6</n> Jubiláte in conspéctu regis Dómini: * moveátur mare, et plenitúdo ejus: orbis terrárum, et qui hábitant in eo.
<n>97:8</n> Flúmina plaudent manu, simul montes exsultábunt a conspéctu Dómini: * quóniam venit judicáre terram.
<n>97:9</n> Judicábit orbem terrárum in justítia, * et pópulos in æquitáte.
09.L98:
<n>98:1</n> Dóminus regnávit, irascántur pópuli: * qui sedet super Chérubim, moveátur terra.
<n>98:2</n> Dóminus in Sion magnus: * et excélsus super omnes pópulos.
<n>98:3</n> Confiteántur nómini tuo magno: quóniam terríbile, et sanctum est: * et honor regis judícium díligit.
<n>98:4</n> Tu parásti directiónes: * judícium et justítiam in Jacob tu fecísti.
<n>98:5</n> Exaltáte Dóminum, Deum nostrum, et adoráte scabéllum pedum ejus: * quóniam sanctum est.
<n>98:6</n> Móyses et Aaron in sacerdótibus ejus: * et Sámuel inter eos, qui ínvocant nomen ejus:
<n>98:6</n> Invocábant Dóminum, et ipse exaudiébat eos: * in colúmna nubis loquebátur ad eos.
<n>98:7</n> Custodiébant testimónia ejus, * et præcéptum quod dedit illis.
<n>98:8</n> Dómine, Deus noster, tu exaudiébas eos: * Deus, tu propítius fuísti eis, et ulcíscens in omnes adinventiónes eórum.
<n>98:9</n> Exaltáte Dóminum, Deum nostrum, et adoráte in monte sancto ejus: * quóniam sanctus Dóminus, Deus noster.
09.E97:
<n>97:1</n> Sing ye to the Lord a new canticle: * because he hath done wonderful things.
<n>97:1</n> His right hand hath wrought for him salvation, * and his arm is holy.
<n>97:2</n> The Lord hath made known his salvation: * he hath revealed his justice in the sight of the Gentiles.
<n>97:3</n> He hath remembered his mercy * and his truth toward the house of Israel.
<n>97:3</n> All the ends of the earth have seen * the salvation of our God.
<n>97:4</n> Sing joyfully to God, all the earth; * make melody, rejoice and sing.
<n>97:5</n> Sing praise to the Lord on the harp, on the harp, and with the voice of a psalm: * with long trumpets, and sound of cornet.
<n>97:6</n> Make a joyful noise before the Lord our king: * let the sea be moved and the fulness thereof: the world and they that dwell therein.
<n>97:8</n> The rivers shall clap their hands, the mountains shall rejoice together at the presence of the Lord: * because he cometh to judge the earth.
<n>97:9</n> He shall judge the world with justice, * and the people with equity.
09.E98:
<n>98:1</n> The Lord hath reigned, let the people be angry: * he that sitteth on the cherubims: let the earth be moved.
<n>98:2</n> The Lord is great in Sion, * and high above all people.
<n>98:3</n> Let them give praise to thy great name: for it is terrible and holy: * and the king’s honour loveth judgment.
<n>98:4</n> Thou hast prepared directions: * thou hast done judgment and justice in Jacob.
<n>98:5</n> Exalt ye the Lord our God, and adore his footstool, * for it is holy.
<n>98:6</n> Moses and Aaron among his priests: * and Samuel among them that call upon his name.
<n>98:6</n> They called upon the Lord, and he heard them: * he spoke to them in the pillar of the cloud.
<n>98:7</n> They kept his testimonies, * and the commandment which he gave them.
<n>98:8</n> Thou didst hear them, O Lord our God: * thou wast a merciful God to them, and taking vengeance on all their inventions.
<n>98:9</n> Exalt ye the Lord our God, and adore at his holy mountain: * for the Lord our God is holy.
09.L91:
<n>91:2</n> Bonum est confitéri Dómino: * et psállere nómini tuo, Altíssime.
<n>91:3</n> Ad annuntiándum mane misericórdiam tuam: * et veritátem tuam per noctem.
<n>91:4</n> In decachórdo, psaltério: * cum cántico, in cíthara.
<n>91:5</n> Quia delectásti me, Dómine, in factúra tua: * et in opéribus mánuum tuárum exsultábo.
<n>91:6</n> Quam magnificáta sunt ópera tua, Dómine! * nimis profúndæ factæ sunt cogitatiónes tuæ.
<n>91:7</n> Vir insípiens non cognóscet: * et stultus non intélleget hæc.
<n>91:8</n> Cum exórti fúerint peccatóres sicut fænum: * et apparúerint omnes, qui operántur iniquitátem:
<n>91:9</n> Ut intéreant in sǽculum sǽculi: * tu autem Altíssimus in ætérnum, Dómine.
<n>91:10</n> Quóniam ecce inimíci tui, Dómine, quóniam ecce inimíci tui períbunt: * et dispergéntur omnes, qui operántur iniquitátem.
<n>91:11</n> Et exaltábitur sicut unicórnis cornu meum: * et senéctus mea in misericórdia úberi.
<n>91:12</n> Et despéxit óculus meus inimícos meos: * et in insurgéntibus in me malignántibus áudiet auris mea.
<n>91:13</n> Justus, ut palma florébit: * sicut cedrus Líbani multiplicábitur.
<n>91:14</n> Plantáti in domo Dómini, * in átriis domus Dei nostri florébunt.
<n>91:15</n> Adhuc multiplicabúntur in senécta úberi: * et bene patiéntes erunt, ut annúntient:
<n>91:16</n> Quóniam rectus Dóminus, Deus noster: * et non est iníquitas in eo.
09.E91:
<n>91:2</n> It is good to give praise to the Lord: * and to sing to thy name, O most High.
<n>91:3</n> To shew forth thy mercy in the morning, * and thy truth in the night:
<n>91:4</n> Upon an instrument of ten strings, upon the psaltery: * with a canticle upon the harp.
<n>91:5</n> For thou hast given me, O Lord, a delight in thy doings: * and in the works of thy hands I shall rejoice.
<n>91:6</n> O Lord, how great are thy works! * thy thoughts are exceeding deep.
<n>91:7</n> The senseless man shall not know: * nor will the fool understand these things.
<n>91:8</n> When the wicked shall spring up as grass: * and all the workers of iniquity shall appear:
<n>91:9</n> That they may perish for ever and ever: * but thou, O Lord, art most high for evermore.
<n>91:10</n> For behold thy enemies, O Lord, for behold thy enemies shall perish: * and all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
<n>91:11</n> But my horn shall be exalted like that of the unicorn: * and my old age in plentiful mercy.
<n>91:12</n> My eye also hath looked down upon my enemies: * and my ear shall hear of the downfall of the malignant that rise up against me.
<n>91:13</n> The just shall flourish like the palm tree: * he shall grow up like the cedar of Libanus.
<n>91:14</n> They that are planted in the house of the Lord * shall flourish in the courts of the house of our God.
<n>91:15</n> They shall still increase in a fruitful old age: * and shall be well treated, that they may shew,
<n>91:16</n> That the Lord our God is righteous, * and there is no iniquity in him.
